name: Michaelson Foreign & Domestic Car Parts
old_description: Since 1926, Michaelson has been working hard to earn its reputation as New Jersey’s top auto recycler.
about:
Michaelson Foreign & Domestic Car Parts has operated from South River, New Jersey since 1926. The business was founded by the Michaelson family and remains family-owned, evolving from a local community-based salvage yard into a nationwide supplier of recycled auto parts.

The company specializes in late-model used auto parts for both foreign and domestic vehicles, including glass and accessories. Its highly organized, meticulously clean facility in South River houses a massive inventory, and the company supplements its own stock through partnerships with leading parts resources across the country. Orders are fulfilled through its e-commerce site and eBay store, with tested parts shipped nationwide.

Michaelson serves the broader automotive community, from individual vehicle owners to repair shops seeking affordable, recycled components. Customers across the United States access its inventory online, relying on the company's part search and fast delivery.

The Michaelson family emphasizes a tradition of unmatched customer service, backed by nearly a century of experience. The company differentiates itself with a clean, well-organized facility, rigorous parts testing, and a nationwide network that ensures hard-to-find components are available.
